title: Qin2023 action observation ECoG: re-referenced region-of-interest electrocorticography during observation of predictable and unpredictable action movies
description: Re-referenced region-of-interest electrocorticography (ECoG) recorded from 10 epilepsy patients (8.70 h, 1000 Hz) while they watched movies of sequential actions that were either predictable or unpredictable. The derivative dataset repackages the authors' FieldTrip structures into BIDS iEEG format with camera-change events, ACPC and MNI electrode positions, and the stimulus movies and annotations. It supports analysis of how predictability alters information flow during action observation.
methods_description: Continuous ECoG was recorded at 1000 Hz in epilepsy patients watching movies of sequential actions. The authors re-referenced the signals and restricted them to region-of-interest channels. These were converted from FieldTrip structures to BrainVision float32 files. Events are camera-change triggers in the movies, annotated with BORIS.
